summary: Scorpio Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing approval to list its American Depositary Shares on the NASDAQ Capital Market under symbol SGLD, with trading commencing September 1, 2026. Each ADS represents 20 common shares, with BNY Mellon as depositary. The company also extended a marketing services agreement with Investor Insights Systems for US$100,000 over three months. This is a routine listing event, not a special-situation transaction, so the filing is classified as None.
